destination.title: Configure destination source
destination.description: In manual mode, Home Assistant searches directly. The optional Geoapify key enables address search. HA zones and Google Maps links containing explicit target coordinates work without a key. Add the Route Progress card to any dashboard to choose a destination.

data_description.geoapify_api_key: Validated when saved. Successful checks are reused for 15 minutes. Without a key, HA zones and supported Maps links remain available.
